description: 按 client_ref 对应，可部分成功。需已注册账号。勿混用三例。(1) 无已完成响应、IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS、幂等锁不可用，或瞬时数据库错误且一条都未创建的 503：同 key 原样重发整批；已完成返回已存结果，不另创建；key 释放则重跑。(2) retryable 为 true：重放不重试该项。只将该项（保留 client_ref）用新 key 发送，不要带已成功项，否则 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT。(3) 校验错误须改正，勿原样重发无效请求。key 未保存的 400（重复 client_ref、缺少 items、BATCH_TOO_LARGE）改正后可复用该 key。retryable 为 false 已保存；修改请求体后继续使用原 key，会返回 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT，改正项须用新 key。 By client_ref. Partial success. Registered account required. Do not mix the three cases. (1) No completed body, IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, unavailable idempotency lock, or 503 when a transient database error created nothing: resend the unchanged batch with the same key. Completed returns the stored result, not a second create. A released key reruns it. (2) retryable true: replay does not retry that item. Send only it, same client_ref, new key, without succeeded items; otherwise IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. (3) Fix validation errors; do not resend the invalid body. A 400 before the key is stored (duplicate client_ref, missing items, BATCH_TOO_LARGE) may reuse the key. retryable false is stored; a changed body returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and needs a new key.

idempotency_key.description: Unique client key. Replays the stored result for 24h.

client_ref.description: Do not join on array index. The link_created event stores client_ref only when it is 1 to 64 characters matching [A-Za-z0-9._:-]. link_create_failed uses the same rule; any other value is omitted.

locale.description: en or zh-CN. Aliases zh-cn, zh-Hans, zh-hans, zh_Hans, zh_hans become zh-CN. Rejects Traditional Chinese, EN, ZH-CN, and bare zh. Blank is en. Does not rewrite URLs, names, or location. Routes stay /zh-cn.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS. Do not send longUrl.

name: shorten_urls

resend_path.description: Where to resend verification email if this would raise the account's limits.
